summaries.en: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un inspected nuclear facilities, emphasizing the multi-domain utilization of tactical nuclear weapons and reaffirming the legitimacy of nuclear possession while rejecting denuclearization demands.
summaries.zh: 朝鲜国务委员长金正恩视察核设施，强调战术核武器的多领域运用，并重申核拥有正当性，拒绝无核化要求。
